title: Automation & Control Contracting
seoTitle: Control Cable & Automation Contracting in Dubai | Voltronix
seoDescription: Automation site contracting in Dubai, UAE. Control cable pulling, cable trays, glanding, termination, field device connections and commissioning support.
heading: Site work that connects your control panels to the equipment they operate.
overview: Voltronix Automation provides site contracting for control and automation installations, including control cable pulling, cable tray and containment work, cable termination and field connections. The installation scope is coordinated with the panel drawings, site layout and the agreed project requirements.
context: We review the cable schedule, routes, equipment locations and access arrangements before confirming the work package. This helps define the materials, installation boundaries, testing and handover responsibilities. Panel supply, PLC/HMI programming and site installation can be coordinated within one project scope or quoted as clearly defined packages.

homepageItems.title: Control Cable Pulling
homepageItems.description: Routing and pulling control and instrumentation cables between panels and field equipment, with cable identification and coordination of the agreed routes.

homepageItems.title: Cable Trays & Containment
homepageItems.description: Cable tray, ladder or trunking installation with supports, fittings and accessories selected around the cable schedule and site arrangement.

homepageItems.title: Glanding & Termination
homepageItems.description: Control cable glanding, ferruling, labelling and termination at the specified panels, junction boxes and field devices.

homepageItems.title: Testing & Site Support
homepageItems.description: Point-to-point and I/O checks, functional verification and commissioning assistance against the agreed drawings and control sequence.

scope.title: Control & Instrumentation Cable Pulling
scope.description: Installation of the agreed control and instrumentation cable circuits, with routing, pulling and identification coordinated against the approved cable schedule and available containment.
points: Cable route review and installation coordination
Cable identification at panels and field connection points
Preparation of installed cable schedules and records

scope.title: Cable Trays, Ladders & Trunking
scope.description: Installation of cable containment and associated supports and fittings, arranged around the specified cable routes and the site layout.
points: Tray, ladder or trunking sections and accessories
Supports and fittings within the agreed installation scope
Coordination of routing, access and cable separation requirements

scope.title: Glanding, Termination & Identification
scope.description: Completion of control cable ends and field connections so circuits can be checked against the panel and equipment drawings.
points: Cable glands and terminations for the specified equipment
Ferrules, terminal references and circuit labels
Point-to-point connection checks and termination records

scope.title: Field Device & Panel Connections
scope.description: Connection of the specified control signals between panels, instruments, sensors, actuators and equipment interfaces.
points: I/O mapping and interface checks against the approved point list
Coordination with equipment suppliers and other site trades

scope.title: Testing & Commissioning Support
scope.description: Verification of the agreed installation and control sequence, with observations recorded for project handover.
points: Cable continuity and point-to-point checks within scope
Field I/O and agreed loop checks
Functional sequence checks, commissioning assistance and handover records

scope.title: Retrofits, Troubleshooting & Maintenance
scope.description: Review of existing control installations to define a practical upgrade, repair or maintenance work package.
points: Identified panel, PLC/HMI or field-circuit modifications

process.title: Review the Requirements
process.description: Share drawings, the cable schedule, equipment list and required operating sequence. Site conditions are reviewed where they affect the scope.

process.title: Confirm the Work Package
process.description: Agree materials, installation boundaries, access arrangements, coordination responsibilities and the testing requirements.

process.title: Build & Install
process.description: Coordinate panel work, containment, cable pulling and terminations against the agreed drawings and site arrangements.

process.title: Verify & Hand Over
process.description: Complete the agreed checks and commissioning support, then provide the installation records and project documentation within scope.

quotationInputs: Single-line diagrams, control drawings and the relevant bill of quantities
Cable types, sizes, lengths and circuit or termination schedules
Tray, ladder or trunking sizes, routes and support requirements
Equipment and panel locations, site access and working arrangements
Required testing, commissioning, documentation and project dates

faq.question: Can the quotation include both control panels and site work?
faq.answer: Yes. Panel engineering and supply can be combined with the agreed cable, containment, termination and commissioning work. The offer identifies the included equipment and installation responsibilities.

faq.question: Can you quote when cable routes or quantities are not final?
faq.answer: Share the available drawings and equipment locations first. If routes, access or quantities need to be checked, a site review can be arranged before the installation scope and price are confirmed.

faq.question: Can you work on an existing control installation?
faq.answer: Existing panel drawings, controller details and field wiring are reviewed before modifications are proposed. The upgrade or maintenance scope and any required site coordination are then agreed.

faq.question: What documentation can be included at handover?
faq.answer: The agreed scope can include panel drawings, cable and terminal identification, I/O records, functional check sheets and records of changes made during installation or commissioning.
